apworld_description: Manual_SFA2_NaruSnake is a Manual Archipelago world for Street Fighter Alpha 2 on Street Fighter Alpha Anthology.
It tracks Arcade, Survival, Dramatic Battle, character unlocks, super combo progression, Shadaloo Emblems, and optional game settings.
